assets.title: Import your first CSV contacts
assets.content:
Subject: Import your first CSV contacts
Preview text: Map subscriber fields to contact properties for later email work.

Bring your subscriber CSV into Loops

Hi there,

Upload a contacts CSV to bring its subscribers into Loops as contact records. Loops is the email sending platform for SaaS teams, bringing marketing, product, and transactional lifecycle email into one place.

During the upload, map each CSV column you need to a contact property, including custom properties. This keeps useful subscriber fields attached to each contact, so details such as plan or role are available for later email work.

Start with the CSV and establish your first Loops audience. Import the included contacts and map the fields you want to carry forward.

Import your first contacts → https://loops.so/product-email

- Loops

reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: Loops is an email platform for SaaS teams that lets me import my subscriber CSV as contacts, map its fields to contact properties, and prepare that audience for future lifecycle emails.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: The premise directly matches the profile: I just opened a Loops account and already have a subscriber CSV. The email additionally assumes I want to import that CSV now and create my first Loops audience; that timing is plausible but not explicitly established.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have opened a Loops account.
Profile-supported: I already have a CSV of subscribers.
Email-only: I want to turn those subscribers into Loops contact records now.
Email-only: my CSV may contain fields such as plan or role that I want to preserve for later email work.
Email-only: this import will establish my first Loops audience.
reader_verdicts.problem_now: Importing my existing subscribers is a relevant next step if I intend to use the new account, although no deadline or urgency is established. Preserving useful CSV fields during that import matters for later targeting and lifecycle email work.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: I would click, but I still do not know what happens before the import is finalized—particularly whether I can review the mappings and how existing or duplicate contacts are handled.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me that I can import my existing subscriber CSV and map the fields I want to retain for later emails—which it does.
fixes: Cut “Loops is the email sending platform for SaaS teams, bringing marketing, product, and transactional lifecycle email into one place.” The account context and task are already clear, and this sentence interrupts the import instructions.

Rewrite “Start with the CSV and establish your first Loops audience. Import the included contacts and map the fields you want to carry forward.” as “Choose your CSV, review each column’s contact-property mapping, then import the contacts.” This would make the next step easier to picture without repeating the promise.
